item.title: Obscura: VPN that can't log your activity
item.description:
📝 Traditional VPNs see your identity and your browsing historyTraditional VPNjacobwilliams@gmail. Obscura never sees your trafficObscura’s servers relay your connection to exit servers but can never decrypt your traffic. Obscura only sees your connecting IP address and necessary payment info – never your actual internet traffic.
🔗 Read more: https://obscura.com/#faq-technical
